scenario.failure_mode: Motor does not start after overload reset
scenario.primary_question: The motor does not start after overload reset. What should I check next?

questions.question: The motor does not start after overload reset. What should I check next?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Check for mechanical lockout pin on OL-1, verify control fuse F2 continuity, inspect Phase Protection Relay PPR-2 for >2.5% phase unbalance or trip LED, check stator thermal switch cool-down (TS1/TS2 open until <90°C), and check resistance across OL-1 terminals 95-96 (<0.5 ohms).
questions.safety_notes: Perform LOTO and verify zero electrical potential before touching internal panel components.

questions.question: What resistance should be measured across control circuit terminals 95 and 96 on overload relay OL-1 during normal conditions?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The normal resistance across OL-1 control terminals 95 and 96 is less than 0.5 Ohms. A reading above 1M Ohm indicates welded or broken contacts.
questions.safety_notes: Disconnect main 460V power before measuring terminal resistance.

questions.question: If the Phase Protection Relay (PPR-2) shows a RED ALARM LED, what is the cause and what should be checked?
questions.expected_answer_summary: A RED ALARM LED on PPR-2 indicates line phase unbalance > 2.5% to 3% or phase loss. Check supply line fuses F1A, F1B, F1C in the main distribution panel and measure line voltage across L1-L2-L3.
questions.safety_notes: Use CAT III 1000V rated multimeter for line voltage checks.

questions.question: How long must the technician wait for stator thermal switches TS1/TS2 to cool down and automatically reset after an over-temperature trip?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Stator thermal switches open at 130°C and require a cool-down period of 20 to 30 minutes (or until temperature drops below 90°C) to automatically reset.
questions.safety_notes: High stator temperature can cause insulation breakdown if restarted immediately; do not force start.

questions.question: In the control circuit wiring diagram (DWG-ELEC-2024-CF5K), which safety components are wired in series before the M1 contactor coil?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Control fuse F2 (2A), ESTOP-1 switch, Overload NC contact OL-1 (95-96), Phase Protection Relay contact PPR-2 (11-14), and Stator Thermal Cutout TS1/TS2 are wired in series.
questions.safety_notes: Ensure 120 VAC control voltage is isolated before inspecting terminal connections.

questions.question: What is the full load current (FLC) and overload trip threshold setting for the CentriFlow Pro 5000 motor?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The full load current (FLC) is 118 Amperes at 460 V, and the default overload trip current threshold is 147.5 Amperes (125% of FLC).
questions.safety_notes: Electrical parameter verification must be conducted by qualified personnel.

questions.question: What rating and type of fuse is specified for control circuit fuse F2?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Control circuit fuse F2 is rated at 2A 250V fast-acting.
questions.safety_notes: Never bypass fuse F2 with jumper wires.

questions.question: What grease type and quantity are required for re-greasing the Drive End (DE) bearing, and what is the service interval?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Inject 15 grams of Mobilith SHC 220 synthetic grease into the Drive End (DE) bearing (6314-C3) every 2000 operating hours.
questions.safety_notes: Do not over-grease as over-greasing causes churning and overheating.

questions.question: What maximum radial offset is allowed during shaft alignment for the CentriFlow Pro 5000?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The maximum radial alignment offset allowed is 0.05 mm (0.002 in).
questions.safety_notes: Ensure pump motor is completely de-energized and locked out prior to shaft alignment.

questions.question: What maximum number of consecutive overload resets is permitted within a 1 hour window according to the field procedure?
questions.expected_answer_summary: No more than 3 consecutive resets are permitted within 1 hour. Repeated resets against an uncorrected fault will destroy stator windings.
questions.safety_notes: Repeated resets without fixing mechanical jam or short circuit can destroy motor stator windings.

questions.question: How do you program the Modbus RTU RS-485 communication address on the digital motor controller?
questions.expected_answer_summary: UNSUPPORTED: The provided seed documentation covers electromechanical control (OL-1, PPR-2, M1) and does not contain information about Modbus RTU RS-485 digital communication protocols or controllers.
questions.safety_notes: N/A - Do not attempt unverified digital controller reprogramming.

questions.question: What is the replacement procedure for the hydraulic variable displacement swashplate assembly on the pump?
questions.expected_answer_summary: UNSUPPORTED: CentriFlow Pro 5000 is a centrifugal slurry pump motor unit; it does not feature a hydraulic variable displacement swashplate assembly.
